none: PAS SWYOR-F1B884: Roman ceramic vessel fragment
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A sherd from the rim of a Roman Mancetter / Hartshill mortarium. The rim of the vessel is wide with a central groove running around its circumference. The sherd is coarse with a cream fabric and smooth cream surface. The fabric has number of small, terracotta inclusions. Large, angular black grits are visible on the interior surface. The fragment weighs 38.6g and measures 47mm in length, 74.15mm…
